name: witness-policy-published
path: JJ's run publishes on his policy, with no approval

name: witness-queued-prd-published
path: Ben's PRD intent is refused by the gate, queued, woken when the MRD is accepted, and published

name: witness-named-person-asked
path: a run asks a decision of a named person who is not its owner

name: witness-answered
path: the person asked answers, and the run takes the answer

name: witness-woken-after-reopen
path: an intent queued on an accepted document is woken by the reopen and starts

name: witness-obligation-met
path: the run publishes, a person accepts the document, and the obligation is met

name: witness-obligation-at-risk-then-met
path: the obligation is at risk, another path is chosen, and it is met

name: witness-obligation-missed
path: the date passes and the obligation is missed

name: witness-obligation-released
path: the obligation is released

name: witness-creditor-told
path: an at-risk or missed obligation reaches its creditor and its debtor

name: witness-failed-run-is-at-risk
path: a run fails and the obligation is at risk, not silently dropped

name: witness-substitute
path: a shortage is settled with units of another model, and picking starts

name: witness-split
path: a shortage is settled by shipping what is held, with the customer agreeing

name: witness-move-date
path: the date moves, the stock arrives, the rest is reserved and picking starts

name: witness-partial-cancel
path: some units are cancelled, the surplus reservation goes back, and the order carries on

name: witness-parent-at-risk
path: the warehouse is at risk and so is the main obligation

name: witness-unknown-found
path: the booking times out, a person checks the portal and finds it

name: witness-unknown-not-found
path: the booking times out, a person finds nothing, and it is asked once more

name: witness-charge-approved
path: a charge that needs approval waits for a person, then happens

name: witness-delivery-met
path: the customer confirms the receipt and the main obligation is met

name: witness-parts-warehouse-at-risk
path: the warehouse is at risk, in an order that also has a carrier booking

name: witness-parts-booking-at-risk
path: the carrier booking is at risk, in an order that also has a warehouse part

name: witness-parts-shortage-then-unknown
path: a shortage settled and the units picked, then the carrier booking unknown: the two risks one after the other

name: witness-rolled-back
path: the lead rolls back, the owner approves the access, and the fix runs

name: witness-escalated
path: the page goes unanswered and the secondary on-call is paged

name: witness-wait-and-meet
path: the lead waits for the engineer fix, a person verifies the restore, and the SLA is met

name: witness-wait-and-miss
path: the lead waits for the fix and the deadline passes: the SLA is missed

name: witness-access-approved
path: the owner approves the access

name: witness-access-denied
path: the owner refuses the access and the lead is sent back to choose

name: witness-access-expired
path: the access reaches the end of its window by itself

name: witness-access-revoked-at-close
path: the access is granted, used, and revoked when the incident closes

name: witness-late-update
path: a customer update is late and the comms obligation is at risk
